name: energy-state-analyzer
description: Visualize code energy states in real-time (Python, F#, TypeScript)

energyStateAnalyzer.nesting.mediumThresh.description: Nesting depth above which control-flow blocks (if/for/while/with) are flagged as medium energy.

energyStateAnalyzer.nesting.highThreshol.description: Nesting depth above which control-flow blocks are flagged as high energy instead of medium.

energyStateAnalyzer.cyclomaticComplexity.description: Cyclomatic complexity above which a function is flagged as medium energy.
Cyclomatic complexity above which a function is flagged as high energy instead of medium.

energyStateAnalyzer.cognitiveComplexity..description: Cognitive complexity above which a function is flagged as medium energy.
Cognitive complexity above which a function is flagged as high energy instead of medium.

energyStateAnalyzer.coherence.largeFunct.description: Line count above which a function counts as 'large' for file coherence purposes.

energyStateAnalyzer.coherence.maxLargeFu.description: Number of large functions (see largeFunctionLines) a file can contain before it's flagged for coherence.

energyStateAnalyzer.magicValues.enabled.description: Whether to flag magic numbers and message-shaped string literals.

energyStateAnalyzer.matchOpportunity.min.description: Number of branches (if + elif/else-if) an if/elif chain must have, all keyed on the same variable, before it's flagged as a match/switch opportunity.

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.highEnergy.description: Color for high-energy violations (background tint, gutter icon, and complexity heatmap). Defaults to a deep amber so it reads as 'hot' rather than duplicating the red used for compiler/lint errors.

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.mediumEnergy.description: Color for medium-energy violations (background tint and gutter icon).

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.lowEnergy.description: Color for low-energy violations (background tint and gutter icon).

energyStateAnalyzer.colors.backgroundOpa.description: Opacity of the background tint applied behind flagged lines.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
